item.title: As Afghanistan’s health infrastructure crumbles, read how India is helping the country after Taliban banned Pakistan’s poor-quality medicines
item.description: India is building a new 30-bed hospital in the Bagrami area of ​​Kabul, an oncology centre for cancer treatment, and a trauma centre for treating serious injuries.

item.title: Maharashtra: Man suffers fractured shoulder, deep injuries as Imran Ahmed Shaikh and two others assault him for shooing away a stray dog; Exclusive FIR details
item.description: The three accused confronted the victims near a Buddha Vihar, accused them of harming a stray dog, followed them as they tried to leave, and launched a coordinated attack before fleeing the scene.

item.title: Maharashtra: 27,397 births recorded for a population of 1,500 in a Yavatmal district village, BJP leader suspects beneficiaries include Bangladeshis; probe underway
item.description: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya visited the village on Wednesday (17th December) and demanded an investigation into the matter.

item.title: Muslims built flats on ancient Hindu temple, non-veg shops opened: Gujarat CM orders investigation into Danilimda controversy, OpIndia ground report reveals shocking details
item.description: It is worth noting that the spire of the temple was also visible in the middle of the building earlier, but now, for a long time now, boards have been put up outside the building in such a way that the spire is covered.

item.title: Thiruparankundram Deepam row: Hindu devotees slam Tamil Nadu govt for ‘undisguised scorn and contempt’ for Hindu faith, forcing surrender of religious rights
item.description: Senior Advocate Sriram accused the state authorities of being biased against Hindus and said that the state wanted coexistence at the cost of Hindus surrendering their rights

item.title: Gujarat HC rejects over 150 petitions by Waqf Boards seeking exemption from court fee, clarifies no petition will be heard if fee not paid
item.description: Gujarat High Court dismissed 150 Waqf petitions, ruling boards must pay court fees like temples and other faiths. It ended years of exemptions under the Waqf Act, clarifying Section 83 proceedings as full litigation. Deputy CM hailed it as historic for equality.

item.title: Pakistan as the Muslim face of Gaza demilitarisation: How Washington and Jerusalem shift the cost and keep the control
item.description: The proposed stabilisation force masks coercive enforcement, permits use of force, sidelines democratic consent, and risks repeating past episodes where Palestinian repression followed foreign intervention, with Pakistan gaining optics but facing blame if violence escalates.

item.title: Major boost for ‘Make in India’: Apple planning to shift its iPhone chip assembly and packaging to India
item.description: Reports say the talks between Indian semiconductor companies and Apple center on outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OAST) processes, particularly, the backend steps of assembling dies into finished chips and packaging them, rather than full chip fabrication.

item.title: SHANTI Bill set to transform healthcare, agriculture, and energy through nuclear power; private sector entry allowed with strong safety safeguards: Here’s what it means for you
item.description: The SHANTI Bill, 2025 opens India’s nuclear energy sector to responsible private participation while strengthening safety, investment, and innovation to drive growth in healthcare, agriculture, clean power, and climate resilience.

item.title: ‘Permit Christmas events only for those officially registered as Christians’: Why Hindus in villages of Dharampur and Kaprada are raising this demand — Ground Report
item.description: Hindu residents of Dharampur and Kaprada say unregulated Christmas events are being used as a tool for illegal religious conversions in tribal villages, prompting them to seek strict verification before granting permissions.
